title: System status page cannot show watchSilent/watchUnreadable: the only source (public /health) is service-wide and /system-status omits them
evidence: apps/web/src/pages/system-status/statusClient.ts now returns watchSilent/watchUnreadable as null always; the page renders 'unavailable (no tenant-scoped source)'. /health carries them but is all-tenant.
fix_direction: If wanted, an API unit adds tenant-scoped watch counts to GET /system-status (or reuses /watch-state), then the client reads them.
notes: Deliberate loss of information to avoid the cross-tenant read; low, not a pulled unit.
